mapper.sql: SELECT q.qualification_id, q.qual_type, q.name, q.cert_no, q.qual_level, q.owner_type, q.owner_user_id, q.owner_name, q.issue_date, q.expire_date, q.warn_days, q.file_url, q.dept_id, q.del_flag, q.create_by, q.create_time, q.update_by, q.update_time, q.remark FROM bid_qualification q
mapper.select: WHERE q.del_flag = '0' AND q.expire_date IS NOT NULL AND q.expire_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL IFNULL(q.warn_days, 60) DAY) AND q.expire_date >= CURDATE()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bid_qualification (qual_type, name, cert_no, qual_level, owner_type, owner_user_id, owner_name, issue_date, expire_date, warn_days, file_url, dept_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{qualType}, #{name}, #{certNo}, #{qualLevel}, #{ownerType}, #{ownerUserId}, #{ownerName}, #{issueDate}, #{expireDate}, #{warnDays}, #{fileUrl}, #{deptId}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: UPDATE bid_qualification SET del_flag = '2' WHERE qualification_id IN #{qualificationId}
